analysis_metadata.objective: Resumen la Full DSA Transparency Database para conocer las narrativas de desinformación activas en España y recupera los ultimos reports de EDMO sobre España
limitations: Live web access restricted during session
Findings based on typical report structures rather than live data extraction
Actual narrative prevalence requires live data acquisition

dsa_transparency_database.description: EU-mandated transparency reports from VLOPs and VLOSEs under the Digital Services Act

election_related.description: False claims about electoral fraud, manipulated content about candidates, misinformation about voting procedures

health_related.description: COVID-19 vaccine misinformation, false health advice, pandemic origin conspiracy theories

immigration_and_demographic.description: False narratives about immigration levels, demographic replacement conspiracy theories, misrepresented crime statistics

geopolitical.description: False narratives about Spain's EU/NATO role, Gibraltar sovereignty disputes, Catalonia/Basque independence misinformation

economic.description: False claims about government spending, financial institution conspiracy theories, misleading unemployment data

platform_actions: Content removal for community standard violations
Reduction in distribution of borderline content

edmo_reports_spain.description: European Commission initiative bringing together fact-checkers, media literacy experts, and researchers to combat disinformation

monthly_disinformation_barometer.description: Top 5 narratives, platform analysis, fact-check verification, audience reach, evolution tracking

thematic_reports.description: Deep dives on specific topics (health, migration, climate)

cross_border_analysis.description: Narratives spreading between Spain and Latin America

narrative_persistence.description: Certain narratives show remarkable durability across reporting periods

platform_migration.description: Disinformation moves from mainstream platforms to encrypted apps (Telegram, WhatsApp)

language_dynamics.description: Increasing use of Spanish-language content with regional variations

cross_regional_links.description: Connections between Spanish disinformation and Latin American narratives

fact_check_effectiveness.description: Measuring reach and impact of fact-checking interventions

dsa_edmo_linkage.narrative_validation: Compare platform-identified narratives (DSA) with fact-checker assessments (EDMO)
dsa_edmo_linkage.platform_attribution: EDMO platform distribution data complements DSA platform-specific actions
dsa_edmo_linkage.impact_assessment: Combine DSA action metrics with EDMO reach estimates
dsa_edmo_linkage.temporal_analysis: Align reporting periods for trend analysis

additional_sources.Academic_Research: Studies from Spanish universities on disinformation

recommendations: Deploy data acquisition scripts to fetch live DSA and EDMO data
Create entity resolution maps for platforms and narratives
Develop temporal analysis of narrative evolution
Build visualization dashboard for narrative tracking
Implement network analysis to trace narrative origins and amplification patterns
Correlate narrative spread with real-world events for impact assessment
